title: Landscape Contracting, B.S. -- Design/Build Option (College of Agricultural Sciences)
notes: Two options exist (Design/Build, Management); built Design/Build as the first-listed, representative pick. New hort_catalog.json (was 2 courses, now 45) and art_catalog.json (was stale/incomplete, now 92 -- ART 20 does exist, the old cached file was just missing it). Handbook cross-check: a real Landscape Contracting Student Handbook PDF exists (plantscience.psu.edu/undergraduate/resources/advisers/landscape-contracting-undergraduate-student-handbook), but its content is scanned/image-based and not text-extractable by this pass's tools; verified against the live bulletin instead. CORRECTED -- the prior note here wrongly claimed 'SPAN 105 and TURF 100 don't exist in the real catalog'. Both are real, current PSU courses (SPAN 105 'Elementary Spanish I for Students in the Agricultural Sciences', 4cr, no prereq -- tailored for this exact student population; TURF 100 'Introduction to Turfgrass Management', 3cr, no prereq) and both are already present in their respective catalog files -- the original claim appears to have been a stale/mistaken scraper read. Re-added both as real alternatives, matching the live bulletin's actual 'SPAN 1, 2, or 105' and 'TURF 100 or 235' wording (SPAN 1/TURF 235 kept first since they were already the plan's working picks). Several variable-credit bulletin rows resolved to their lower value. CHEM 130 (3cr) used instead of CHEM 101 (2cr) -- both need MATH 21 either way. ACCTG 211 and CHEM 130 both real-prereq MATH 21, which this major's own required math (MATH 26, Trigonometry) doesn't satisfy, so MATH 21 was added explicitly (Semester 2) rather than leaving them permanently unschedulable. AUDIT CORRECTION (LSCPE reviewer pass): a prior version of this note additionally scheduled MATH 3 (Semester 1) and MATH 4 (Semester 2) as literal credit-bearing plan items, reasoning that MATH 21 itself needs MATH 4 needs MATH 3 on the live bulletin. That chain is real on the live PSU Math Placement page, but this repo's own math_placement.py already encodes it correctly: MATH 3 and MATH 4 are NON_DEGREE_APPLICABLE_MATH, unconditionally treated as satisfied by expand_math_placement (their own catalog descriptions say they 'may not be used to satisfy the basic minimum requirements for graduation in any baccalaureate degree program') -- so no plan should ever list them as scheduled, credit-bearing requirements. Removed both; MATH 21 alone remains, which is both necessary (unblocks ACCTG 211/CHEM 130) and sufficient (its own prereq is covered by the unconditional MATH 3/4 waiver upstream, and by this app's own cached MATH 21 catalog entry, which currently carries no prereq at all). This also fixed two semester target_credits/actual-item-sum mismatches the extra items had introduced (Semester 1 was quietly 20cr against a stated 17cr target; Semester 2 was 21cr against a stated 18cr target). Total is now 124cr, back within the bulletin's own stated 120-126cr range. PPEM 318 (2cr, no prereq) picked over ENT 313/314, HORT 238, or PPEM 300 for that pool, matching its own 2cr lower bound cleanly. BA 250 (no prereq) picked over BA 304/HORT 455, avoiding HORT 455's own ECON 102/AGBM 101 prereq entirely.
